title: SpaceMC
description: Quality of life additions for the vanilla SpaceMC server in order to give a better, modded experience to the user!
body:
# SpaceMC Modded
This is a Fabric modpack containing QoL (Quality of Life) mods for the minecraft server such as Simple Voice Chat, PingWheel and more!

DO NOTE that the modpack is NOT required as vanilla works too! It mostly lets the user have a better experience interacting with SpaceMC than with a vanilla client.

## What does it include?
The SpaceMC modpack includes optimization mods, such as Sodium, Lithium and more in order to have a smooth game experience while playing in the server as well as community related mods (very important!) such as Simple Voice Chat and PingWheel as stated in the beginning.

This permits in having a better interaction with the server's mechanics as well with the other players.
